diagnostic_evidence.quote: where $\VV_{\ell}^+$ consists of the new vertices of $\TT_{\ell}$ along with their neighboring vertices in $\VV_{\ell} \cap \VV_{\ell-1}$.

issues.failure_explanation: The sum X^1_{l-1} + X^+_l = X^1_l holds, but it is not direct. For an interior old vertex z in V^+_l (its patch changed), the coarse hat φ_{l-1,z} equals φ_{l,z} plus a combination of hats at new vertices, all of which lie in X^+_l; hence φ_{l-1,z} ∈ X^1_{l-1} ∩ X^+_l ≠ {0}. Equivalently dim X^1_{l-1} + dim X^+_l = #V_{l-1} + #V^+_l > #V_l = dim X^1_l whenever such a vertex exists, which is generic under bisection.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace ⊕ by + (non-direct sum), or drop the remark.
issues.overall_effect: The displayed decomposition statement is false; nothing later relies on directness (only on X^+_l ⊆ X^1_l and the span description), so no result is affected.
issues.title: Claimed direct sum X^1_l = X^1_{l-1} ⊕ X^+_l is false
issues.why_classification: Purely local false side remark with no downstream use; a one-symbol correction preserves everything.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: use a symmetric and positive definite preconditioner $\vec{B}_{\ell}$ such that the condition number of the preconditioned matrix $\vec{B}_{\ell}^{-1/2} \vec{A}_{\ell} \vec{B}_{\ell}^{-1/2}$ is bounded independently of $h$ and $p$

issues.failure_explanation: Section 3.1 first treats B_l as an approximation of A_l (transformed system B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2}, x̃ = B^{1/2}x), but the derived iteration (p^0 = B r^0, α_k = |r|_B^2/|p|_A^2) and all later preconditioners (B^{sMG}, B^{AS} ≈ A^{-1}) use B ≈ A^{-1}. With B ≈ A^{-1}, B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2} is similar to B^{-1}A ≈ A^2, and cond_2(B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2}) = cond(B^{-1}A) ≠ cond_A(BA) in general (A = diag(1,2), B = diag(2,1): left side 4, right side 1). Also the transformed-variable definitions (x^k = B^{-1/2}x̃^k, r^k = B^{1/2}r̃^k) yield p^0 = B^{-1}r^0, not B r^0.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use one convention: with B ≈ A^{-1}, set x̃ = B^{-1/2}x, transformed matrix B^{1/2}AB^{1/2}, and state cond_2(B^{1/2}AB^{1/2}) = cond_A(BA) in (eq: condition numberfor PCG) and in both corollaries.
issues.overall_effect: The identity (eq: condition numberfor PCG) and the first equalities displayed in the statements of the two corollaries are false as written; the substantive content (bounds on cond_A(BA), hence PCG contraction with B applied to residuals) is unaffected.
issues.title: Inconsistent preconditioner convention: cond_2(B^{-1/2}AB^{-1/2}) = cond_A(BA) is false
issues.why_classification: A consistent exponent-sign correction repairs all occurrences; every guarantee (condition-number bounds, contraction rates) survives unchanged.

issues.failure_explanation: As written the definitions do not reproduce Algorithm sMG: (a) the pre-smoothing product runs over i = l,…,l'-1 instead of i = l,…,l'+1, so B↓_{l'} includes the factors for levels l' and l'-1 that have not yet been visited (for l' = l-1 the intended single factor i = l is not obtained under any product convention); (b) D_0^+ := λA lacks the subscript 0 and, more importantly, B↑_0 = I_0^+(λA_0)^{-1}(I_0^+)^T ∏_{i=l}^{0}(…) contains the i = 0 factor (I - A I_0 A_0^{-1} I_0^T), and (I_0^+)^T(I - A I_0 A_0^{-1}(I_0^+)^T) = 0, so B↑_0 = 0 as defined, while the coarse correction should be A_0^{-1}-scaled with coefficient 1, not (λA_0)^{-1}. Consequently the asserted identities s↓ = B↓ r, s↑_0 = B↑_0 r fail, and B^{sMG} in (eq: sMG preconditioner) does not equal the update of Algorithm sMG nor satisfy (eq: symmetric multigrid preconditioned matrix) as literally defined.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the index ranges (∏_{i=l}^{l'+1} for B↓_{l'}; ∏_{i=l}^{1} for the pre-smoothing part of B↑_{l'}, with the coarse factor (I - A I_0 A_0^{-1} I_0^T) included only for l' ≥ 1), set D_0^+ := A_0 with coefficient 1 for B↑_0, and verify (eq: symmetric multigrid preconditioned matrix).
issues.overall_effect: The formal definition of B^{sMG} is inconsistent with the algorithm it is meant to encode; the subsequent lemma and corollary are stated for the intended (correct) operator I - E E^{T_A}, which the literal definition does not deliver.
issues.title: Matrices B↓, B↑ defining the symmetric MG preconditioner are mis-specified
issues.why_classification: The intended construction is evident from Algorithm sMG and the derivation in Section 4; fixing indices and the coarse-level scaling is local and preserves all claims.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Let us denote by $\Psi_{\ell}: \XX_{\ell}^p \rightarrow \XX_{\ell}^p$ the iteration map of a uniformly contractive solver
Compute $u_{\ell}^k \coloneqq \Psi_{\ell}(u_{\ell}^{k-1})$ with one step of the algebraic solver.

issues.failure_explanation: Section 7 assumes a solver given by a map Ψ_l: X_l^p → X_l^p with u_l^k = Ψ_l(u_l^{k-1}). GPCG and PCG iterates depend on the previous search direction p^k (step (iii)), so the next iterate is not a function of u_l^{k-1} alone and no such Ψ_l exists. What is established (Theorems general result, main result, CG convergence) is per-step contraction of the iterate sequence, which is a different (weaker in form) hypothesis than the one stated.

failure_location.quote: The iterative solvers $\Psi_{\ell}$ consisting of GPCG with $\B_{\ell}^{\MG}$ preconditioner or PCG with either $\vec{B}^{\AS}_{\ell}$ or $\vec{B}^{\SMG}_{\ell}$ preconditioner fulfill the assumptions of this section.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Formulate the solver assumption as contraction of the iterates ‖u_l^* - u_l^k‖ ≤ q‖u_l^* - u_l^{k-1}‖ (with restart at each level) instead of an iteration map, matching the cited theory.
issues.overall_effect: The stated verification of the Section 7 assumptions for the Krylov-type solvers is formally incorrect; the cited complexity theory (GHPS21, BFMPS23) in fact only needs sequence contraction, so the conclusion is recoverable.
issues.title: GPCG/PCG are not iteration maps Ψ_l of u_l alone as assumed in Section 7
issues.why_classification: A rephrasing of the hypothesis aligned with the cited results resolves it; no rate or guarantee changes.
